dedupe_keys.name: hydropower plants in vietnam by june 2016

description: Hydropower plants in Vietnam by June 2016 is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Vietnam. The dataset includes hydropowers recognized on Google Earth. It is still under-construction. Major source for the dataset comes from WLE 2016 ( cgiar. org/maps/). In addition, data and information has been collected from various online public websites. There are three scales of hydropower: Small ( 100 MW) The dataset is presented at country level. Coverage: Viet Nam. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Vietnam. Its tags are Energy. It offers 14 resource(s) in csv, db_table, geojson, kml, wms. The portal shows 2020-07-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
